title: KR-Housing-LongRAG-Bench
description: A copyright-safe Korean long-context benchmark for evaluating long-context LLMs, RAG systems, and table/tool pipelines over real housing announcements, public tabular data, and housing statutes. The public release contains QA labels, evidence locators, deterministic predicates, answerability labels, split and provider/region metadata, and long-context-bundle references. It does not redistribute raw PDF/HWP/HWPX documents, bundle text, the model input prompts (which contain bundle text), reasoning traces, or API keys. v0.9.5 keeps the 1,997 QA, questions, splits, gold fixes, evaluation scope (1,876 evaluated items), verdicts and every reported number of v0.9.4, and adds the final answer text of every judged prediction (24,074 model answers in results/predictions_v0.9.5/, mirroring the verdict files; reasoning traces and the unreported qwen3.5 runs excluded; one source-text span of 200 or more characters and 6 unverified phone numbers masked). The model answers are not covered by CC BY 4.0, remain subject to each model provider's terms of use, are released for reproducing and re-judging the evaluation, and must not be used to train competing models. The release is not leaderboard-ready and has no sealed hidden split. v0.9.6 adds a pre-specified run: dense bge-m3 k=50 plus the whole announcement page as one passage on the 18 aggregation items whose k=50 passages lacked it (two announcement-table pairs); gpt-5.5, minimax-m3, glm-5.2 and claude-sonnet-5-5 rise from 0 to 15-18 of 18 (primary judge). Verdicts, model answers (not covered by CC BY 4.0) and scripts are released; the pre-specification document is in results/judge_verdicts_v0.9.6/PRESPECIFICATION.md. v0.9.7 adds a full human review of the 1,534 evaluated dev items (each item labeled independently by two of four non-author annotators; 120 confirmed errors, 7.8%): 79 gold answers corrected, 30 evidence locators fixed, and 11 items excluded from evaluation (1,523 evaluated dev items), with the dev predictions on the corrected items re-judged under both judges (pooled accuracy changes by at most 1.1 points). It also adds a second judge-validation sample of 216 predictions labeled by two annotators, on which the primary judge agrees with all 200 adjudicated labels of the main sample (Wilson 95% lower bound 98.1%). Questions, splits, and test_public gold answers and verdicts are unchanged. v0.9.8 changes no data or number: it adds a machine-readable new_locator column (30 items, 31 page mappings) to data/errata_v0.9.7.csv, updates the review and recall scripts to write and read it, and corrects three statements in the v0.9.7 release notes.
